title: Lear and the stealth fighter story given to Ned Day

tellings.quote: He did break the story of the stealth fighter, but it was Ned Day.

related.note: The same leak of the stealth fighter (F-117) by John Lear, but Corbell says Lear gave it to Ned Day, not George Knapp.

plain: In the 1980s, the pilot John Lear is said to have broken the story of the stealth fighter, a secret US jet built to avoid radar, but he did it by passing it to the Las Vegas journalist Ned Day. The filmmaker Jeremy Corbell tells this on Michels' show from what he was told, also naming the Las Vegas TV reporter George Knapp. The point of the story is that Lear really did have inside access to secret military projects.
